concept: A slotted TPU 95A bend core + 2 antagonistic Dyneema tendons
print: axis horizontal (lying), gaps vertical, no supports except the 14 mm bore arch (teardrop it); webs 3 mm wide TPU: bench-test fatigue at 7.7% strain
caveats: R rigid stage (z 496-503) occupies the core volume in wrist_rotary v2: it must move above plane B or the core must replace the rotor neck
tendon E_eff, MBL and TPU E are assumptions
core buckling stabilised by tendon pre-tension (tendon stiffness about x 1.1 N.m/deg)
